$comment: Retrieval-latency budget (enterprise retrieval M3). Enforced deterministically by scripts/check-retrieval-latency.mjs (`npm run check:retrieval-latency`), which measures keiko-workspace searchText over a FIXED synthetic in-memory repository of fixtureFileCount files. The budget is a generous p95 CEILING (~4x the observed local p95) so it catches algorithmic regressions (e.g. an accidental O(n^2) candidate scan) without flaking on CI machine variance. Methodology: warmupIterations discarded, then `iterations` timed runs of a project-metadata query; the `percentile` of those durations must stay <= budgetMs.
